changelog.title: What's New in 7.2.5
items: Advanced Settings moved to its own modal with a dedicated Save Configuration button
Modern left-to-right switch toggles for every setting
New advanced settings: notification duration, max simultaneous notifications, launch to library, hide offline friends, reduce animations, UI notification sounds
Streak now shows next to your username (from day 3) — one clean 🔥N with no extra chip
Spinning loading overlay for library sync and profile switching
Remade, calmer UI sounds (soft filtered clicks, airy whooshes, muted two-tone chime)
Accent color picker now lives at the top of the Theme Shop with live preview; Settings has a Themes button in its place
2 new free themes: Aurora Borealis, Volcanic Ash
New achievements: Theme Collector (rewards the Chrome Aurora theme), Bibliophile
Fixed saving Advanced Settings wiping stored credentials
Fixed the username getting stuck on "User not configured"
Fixed achievements only processing when applying a theme — they now process on launch, sync and every 5 minutes
Fixed some games (non-Steam) not appearing correctly inside collections
Fixed profile right-click menu rendering underneath other UI elements
Fixed the shimmer skeleton effect cutting off mid-sweep — one clean left-to-right motion now
Fixed rapid game-modal closing spamming the whoosh sound
Fixed the favorites star icon failing to render (malformed SVG path)

news.title: SteamLite 7.2.5 — Settings Overhaul & Bug Fixes
news.content: Version 7.2.5 gives Settings a dedicated Advanced Settings modal with modern switch toggles and new options (notification duration and stacking, launch to library, hide offline friends, reduce animations, notification sounds). The accent color picker moved to the top of the Theme Shop, the streak now shows next to your username, library syncs show a spinning loading overlay, and UI sounds have been remade softer and calmer. Also includes 2 new free themes (Aurora Borealis, Volcanic Ash), 2 new achievements (Theme Collector, Bibliophile), and fixes for a credential-wiping settings bug, the username getting stuck on 'User not configured', achievement processing, collections, the profile menu, the shimmer effect and more.

news.title: SteamLite 7.2.0 — Achievements, Streaks & Modern UI
news.content: Version 7.2.0 added SteamLite-exclusive achievements with 14 trackable goals, a daily play streak system with celebration animations, 6 locked reward themes, 2 new free themes, and a full modern UI refresh.
